name: caremate-ecosystem
description: CareMate monorepo — mobile, admin portal, shared Supabase schema

scripts.ingest:dev: cd caremate-provider-ingestion && (test -d .venv || python3.12 -m venv .venv) && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8090
scripts.ingest:test: cd caremate-provider-ingestion && (test -x .venv/bin/python || python3.12 -m venv .venv) && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/pytest --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w caremate-mobile && npm run lint -w caremate-admin-portal && npm run lint -w caremate-provider-portal && npm run lint -w caremate-community-portal
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w caremate-mobile && npm run typecheck -w caremate-admin-portal && npm run typecheck -w caremate-provider-portal && npm run typecheck -w caremate-community-portal && npm run typecheck -w caremate-payment-gateway && npm run typecheck -w caremate-website && npm run typecheck -w caremate-health-data-gateway
scripts.test: npm run test -w caremate-mobile && npm run test -w caremate-admin-portal && npm run test -w caremate-payment-gateway && npm run ingest:test && npm run test:email-templates
